tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gur gyi mgon po khro bo bcu gcig gi rjes gnang bya tshul bdud kyi dpung tshogs zil gyis gnon par byed pa'i me 'od ces bya ba bzhugs// rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra shwa ra na ya ka wa ra dharmā dza ra bud+dha dh+wa dza ya na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo'i dbang phyug 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab brjid char sprin nam mkha'i mdog /rab 'byams yon tan rgyud mnga' ba/ /rab 'bar gnas la gus btud nas/ /gang de'i gdams pa bsam yas pa/ /sa skya'i gong ma'i thugs mnga' yang / /chos zab rdo rje'i brag rdzong la/ /brten nas zab mo'i don nyams su/ /len par byed la lhag par du/ /dgos pa'i khro bcu'i rjes gnang bri/ /'di la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ mgon khang la sogs pa gong ma'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas sam/ dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i sa phyogs su gtsang ma'i stegs la 'bru gcal du bkram pa'i steng maṇ+ḍal la rdul tshon gyi chos 'byung me ris dang bcas pa'i dbus su 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bcu pa'i lte ba dang rtsibs steng rnams su nyi gdan re re dang bcas pa bris pa'i steng du tshon nag gi tshom bu bcu gcig bkod/ 'god tshul steng shar g.yas dang / 'og nub g.yon te phur ba lugs bzhin byas na legs pa 'dra snyam sems shing / rdul tshon gyi ri mo de tsam ma nus na maṇ+ḍal steng nas nag tshom bu bcu gcig bkod pa'i khar man 'dzi'i steng lcags sder la sogs pa'i snod du gtor ma gru gsum che ba gcig gi mthar de lta bu chung ba bcu'i mtha' mtheb kyus bskor ba dang bcas pa bzhag pa'i mdun du 'bul gtor dam rdzas shig dang / chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa lnga sgor mchod du bsham/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril nang mchod sogs dang / slob ma la dgos pa'i me tog maṇ+ḍal la sogs pa dgos pa'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med par bya ba ni sbyor ba'i chos so/

/gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdag bskyed pa/ mdun bskyed bsgrub pa/ rjes gnang gsum las/ dang po ni/ thog mar gnas yo byin rlabs sa los mdzad pa'i dgra bgegs gnad gcod kyi spu gri nang bzhin byas la/ de nas sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun rin gyis mdzad pa'i srung 'khor bar chad kun sel ji lta ba bzhin nyams su blangs te srung 'khor bsdus grub pa'i bar byed pa ni bdag bskyed yin la/ gnyis pa mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/ mdun bskyed kyi rten rnams la dmigs nas oṃ shu n+ya ta zhes pa nas/ rigs bdag rgyas 'debs grub pa'i bar yan bdag mdun gyi khyad par ma gtogs bdag bskyed bzhin byas la/ de nas gtor ma sbyangs bdugs byas rjes/ byin rlabs dang kyai rdor gtor bsngo gnyis sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang pos bsgrigs pa bzhin bya/ de nas bya khyung gi phyag rgya sngags dang bcas pas slar yang gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ shā sa na bdun nam/ bcu gcig mdun bskyed la phul la/ phyi mchod dang nang mchod/ yi ge bcu gnyis ma'i mjug tu 'bru gsum btags pas phul la bstan pa snying khong du bcangs pa'i 'phrin bcol dang / srin gzugs ma'i bstod pa bya'o/ /de nas gzhi bdag la gtor ma sbyin tshul yang sngags 'chang chen pos bsgrigs pa'i gtor bsngo nang bzhin 'dir yang byas na legs sam sems/ de nas mdun bskyed la dmigs nas yi ge bcu gnyis ma/ bdun ma/ shā sa na rnams ji ltar rigs par bzlas tshar ba dang / gsum pa rjes gnang ni/ slob ma rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor du smin byed kyi dbang thob pa bdun nam lnga sogs khrus byas gral la 'khod/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu tshar ba dang / slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsal btab/ lo rgyus rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la bshad/ 'o de lta bu'i khyad par du 'phags pa'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba dang /

slob ma'i bya ba gnyis las/ dang po slob dpon gyi bya ba bdag bskyed cing bzlas pa bya ba/ mdun gyi gtor ma tshom bu sogs srung 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par bskyed de ye shes pa dgug gzhug dbang bskur/ rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas 'debs gtor 'bul mchod bstod bzlas pa dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa legs par grub zin nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba la/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang rdo rje nag po chen po tha dad med pa la rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu/ zhes brjod/ phul tshar ba dang / de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ byas la/ gang gi drin gyis nas/ pad la 'dud ces pa'i bar dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /bla ma mchog la bdag gsol 'debs/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen ye shes nas/ bka' drin skyobs kyi bar dang / khyod zhabs pad+mo nas/ gnang bar mdzod kyi bar gyi rjes zlos rnams tshar ba dang / de nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal tshom bu gtor ma dang bcas pa mgon po khro bo bcu'i rten dang brten par bcas par gsal ba'i steng gi cha la dpal kyai rdo rje gtso bor gyur pa'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ de'i steng gi char rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang mtha' skor du sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba sprin phung 'thib pa ltar bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams 'khod de sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa tshul bzhin du bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ byas la/ dkon mchog gsum la nas/ 'grub par shog gi bar gyi rjes zlos rnams grub pa dang / de ltar rgyud dag par byas nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/

byas la/ rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag la rdo rje nag po chen po khro bo bcu'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs kyi byin gyis rlobs la rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes pa'i rjes zlos rnams grub pa dang / de ltar khyad par gyi gsol ba btab nas/ de nas sku'i rjes gnang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams kyi tha mal gyi snang zhen thams cad nam mkha' lta bur gyur/ de'i ngang las sum̐ las rdo rje'i brag rdzong zhes pa nas/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs grub pa yan chad rang gzhan gyi dbye ba ma gtogs bdag bskyed bzhin las/ nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag dang bcas pa re re gsal lam ste gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod/ de nas slob dpon la gus 'dud dung dung ba zhig mdzod/ de ltar byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed dang 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka sogs nas ye shes pa'i lha tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la sib sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la rol mo bya/ slob ma gu gul gyis bdug cing / yi ge bcu gnyis ma dang / bdun ma/ shā sa na rnams kyi mjug tu a be sha ya aḥ zhes mang du brjod yun ji ltar rigs pa tshar ba dang spos rol bzhag la/ de'i mtha' rten du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ snying khar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa rnams gsal lam ste byung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ spyi bo'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus mthu rnams bsdus nas oṃ la thim/

oṃ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros lus thams cad khyab/ lha 'dre'i byad du bcug pa sogs lus kyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar byas/ lus rdo rje'i sku lta bur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzad nas rig pa brjod med du zhog mdzod/ ces brjod/ de bzhin du gsung dang thugs la rigs 'gre shes par bya'o/ /gsung gi rjes gnang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams slob dpon la gus 'dud dung dung ba zhig byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs kha'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng chad de/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying kha'i hūm̐ gi mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod la sngags 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos lan gsum re mdzad pa zhu/ byas la yi ge bcu gnyis ma sogs sngags gsum po rim bzhin brjod/ de nas khyed rang rnams 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ mgon po bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /mgon po bdag la 'go bar mdzod/ /ces brjod/ rjes zlos rnams grub pa dang / de'i mtha' rten du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi lce'i rtsa bar ram̐ dmar nag re gsal lam lam byung bar mos la/ de las 'od zer me phung du 'bar bas ngag gi bar chad thams cad bsregs shing lce rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur pa'i dbus su hūm̐ dkar po mtha' dbyangs gsal gyis bskor ba dang / rdo rje rtse phyogs kyi rwa'i nang du badz+ra dzi hā rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa'i yig 'bru rnams 'grengs tshar mgo gyen bstan dang bcas pa re re gsal lam lam byung bar mos la/ de las 'od zer me phung du 'bar bas ngag gi mi mthun phyogs thams cad bsregs nas ngag nus ldan du byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzad nas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byas la/ badz+ra dzi hā rak+ṣa sogs lan gsum brjod/ de nas thugs kyi rjes gnang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po dung dung ba zhig mdzod/

de ltar byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed dang 'og min sogs nas thugs kyi rang bzhin rnam pa rgyal mtshan gri gug sogs mtshon cha bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ de dag gis dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus smin mtshams kyi thad kyi khru gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la 'od du phung phung gnas pa la sems gtad pas mthar 'od sngon po bde ba chen po'i rnam pa can du ltem gyis zhu nas snying khar thim pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la rol mo dang spos bdugs bya/ yi ge bcu gnyis ma sogs sngags rnams brjod yun ji ltar rigs pa tshar ba dang spos rol bzhag la/ de'i mtha' rten du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer phra mo dpag tu med pa 'phros pas lus thams cad la rdo rje'i go khrab kyis gtams pa'i mos pa mdzod ces brjod/ de rnams kyis sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang song nas/ 'phrin las gtor ma la brten nas bka' bsgo ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod byas la/ slob dpon gyis khro bcu'i gtor ma lag tu blangs te/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas tshom bu gtor ma sogs khro bo bcu gcig rten dang brten par gsal ba de nyid khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i thad kar byon par mos la/ de'i steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs sprin phung 'thib pa ltar du bzhugs pa la da ltar gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i phyag tu dam tshig rdo rje thogs te nag po chen po'i spyi bor bzhag nas/ bka' bsgos pa bzhin brgyud pa'i bla ma la sogs pa rnams kyis kyang bka' bsgos pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sa ma ya sma ra si/ sa ma ya ma tiṣ+ṭha ma tha/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ bram ze mchog sred/

bde ba'i rdo rje/ shad+dha ka ra warma/ rin chen bzang po/ yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po/ 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ bzang po dpal ba/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ gzungs kyi dpal ba/ bzang po rgyal mtshan/ dge ba rgyal mtshan/ sangs rgyas mchog skyes mchog rgyal mtshan/ bkra shis seng ge tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ yongs 'dzin mkhyen brtse ba/ mkhas mchog byams pa rab brtan/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mkhyen cing brtse ba'i ngang nas nus mthu thams cad gcig tu bsdus te skal ldan gyi 'gro ba rnams smin grol la bkod pa'i phyir bsam bzhin du mi'i gzugs su sku sprul pa deng sang gangs can gyi khrod 'dir mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang ldan pa'i bshes gnyen kun gyi gtsug rgyan du gyur pa bka' drin can gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs la bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba ba dang / 'go ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ 'di rnams la gzugs can dgra'i gnod pa/ gzugs med bgegs kyi gnod pa/ pha rol gyi rbod gtong mnan gtad gzer gsum la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi zhing mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams la sogs pa'i legs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas te lha 'dre mi gsum gyi 'gro ba ma lus pa dbang du 'dus nas bsam don thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub ste bstan pa rin po che 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / byang chub ma thob kyi bar gyi sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes bka' bsgos pas nag po chen pos kyang de bzhin du bgyi'o/

/zhes zhal gyis bzhes par mos la de la legs so sbyin pa'i tshul du bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams 'od du zhu nas nag po chen po la thim/ rten dang 'khor rnams kyang 'od du zhu gtso bo la thim/ de nyid kyang 'od sngon po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du zhu nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim pas lus ngag yid gsum dang dbyer med du 'dres pa'i mos pa mdzod ces brjod/ mdun bskyed la nas nag tshom bu bkod yod na skabs 'dir slob ma rnams la tshon pa re ster/ spos bdugs dang rol mo bya/ yi ge bcu gnyis ma sogs sngags gsum po dang / dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes mang du brjod/ yun ji ltar rigs pa tshar ba dang spos rol bzhag la/ 'o de rnams kyis rjes gnang legs par grub pa yin pas de dag gi gnas skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin bgyi'o dgongs pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs brjod/ de nas gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal yon 'bul gnyis gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar shes par bya'o/ /de rnams kyi sgo nas dpal rdo rje nag po chen po khro bo bcu gcig gi rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya che bar mdzod/ byas la/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod/ slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtong ngo / /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang / nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs gtor mgron rten med rnams gshegs gsol byas la rang nyid gur gyi mgon por gsal ba'i gnas gsum bsrung la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sogs dang / bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams/ /sogs kyi smon lam dang bkra shis rgyas par bya'o/ /zhes dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po khro bo bcu gcig gi rjes gnang bya tshul bdud kyi dpung tshogs zil gyis gnon par byed pa'i me 'od ces bya ba 'di ni/

snyigs dus kyi blo dman 'ga' la phan phyir nges pa'i don du drug pa rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis shing / kun rdzob snang ngor bshes gnyen chen po gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon mkhyen thogs med du mnga' ba'i tshul ston par mdzad pa'i yongs 'dzin dam pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes yongs la grags pa'i 'brel tshad don dang ldan nges pa de nyid las gdams pa rgya mtsho'i bka' drin nos shing / lhag par chos tshul 'di nyid legs par thob pa sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos tshul 'di nyid kyi yig cha rnying pa 'ga' la brten cing / der mi gsal la cho ga lhag pa'i skyon mi 'byung ba kha cig gzhan nas kha bskangs te dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o/ /chos tshul 'di ni sa skya pa las brgyud/ /brgyud pa gzhan gyis 'gran pa'i mtha' dang bral/ /bral zhes dam pa kun gyis bsngags par mdzad/ /mdzad pa de ni nges pa'i don dang ldan/ /rnam mkhyen bla ma dam pa'i bka' drin gyis/ /rnam mang 'gro ba'i don la blo gzhol nas/ /rnam dag bstan pa rab tu 'phel ba'i phyir/ /rnam par bshad 'di phyogs kun rgyas gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ gur gyi mgon po khro bo bcu gcig gi rjes gnang bya tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
